title: Input validation and edge cases
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; pure functions.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: `text` must be a `str`. Anything else (`None`, `int`, `bytes`) is rejected.
The format is exactly `SKU:QTY` with exactly one colon.
SKU is three ASCII capital letters, a hyphen, four ASCII digits (`ABC-1234`). No surrounding whitespace, no trailing newline.
QTY is a decimal number of ASCII digits without sign, whitespace, underscores, or leading zeros, and between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
Lines are separated by commas; every line is validated by `parse_order_line`. Whitespace around a comma is not tolerated.
An empty string, an empty line (including a trailing or doubled comma) is rejected.
At most 20 lines. The same SKU may not appear twice.
